_comment: Run from packages/gateway-whatsapp (pnpm --filter @theokit/gateway-whatsapp run test:mutation); deliberately NOT wired into `test`, so `pnpm -r run test` in CI never pays for it. The pattern is copied from packages/gateway, which was the only package in this repo ever measured this way. mutate is scoped to the three files that are pure logic and nothing else: allowlist.ts decides WHO MAY TALK TO THE BOT, split.ts decides where a long message breaks, errors.ts maps platform failures onto typed codes. adapter.ts is excluded because it is I/O orchestration whose tests drive a fake backend, and the bridge is a .mjs child process Stryker cannot instrument. break=95 is the MEASURED baseline (95.86% on 2026-08-30) with headroom for two mutants of ~0.59% each. The first run of this config scored 73.96%; the difference is 37 mutants killed by tests written against them, not by scope changes -- the mutate list has not moved. Every remaining survivor is enumerated with its reason in tests/MUTATION.md, and anything not on that list is outstanding work. Raise this when the score rises; never lower it to make a red run green under an unchanged scope.
